description: A port of the GENDYN synthesis of Iannis Xenakis: the wave is a run of points whose heights and spacings are moved at random within limits

params.text: Picks the distribution the heights are drawn from: UNI, CAUCHY, LOGIST, HYPERBCOS, ARCSINE, EXP or EXT
Shapes the distribution the heights are drawn from, 0 to 1; with EXT chosen it attenuates the Amp Ext jack instead
Sets how far each height is allowed to move from one pass to the next, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the Amp Distribution Param jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Amp Scale jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Picks the distribution the spacings are drawn from: UNI, CAUCHY, LOGIST, HYPERBCOS, ARCSINE, EXP or EXT
Shapes the distribution the spacings are drawn from, 0 to 1; with EXT chosen it attenuates the Dur Ext jack instead
Sets how far each spacing is allowed to move from one pass to the next, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the Duration Distribution Param jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent, despite its tooltip reading Duration Dist Scale CV
Attenuates the voltage at the Duration Scale jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 1; the maker left this knob unnamed, so it has no tooltip
Sets how far the pitch is allowed to wander either side of the note, 0 to 1 of an octave
Nothing in the module reads this knob; the random source cannot be seeded
Sets how many points the wave is drawn through, 1 to 11

inputs.text: Picks that distribution by voltage in place of the knob, 0-10V across the seven settings
The outside signal the heights are taken from while the distribution is set to EXT, scaled by the knob beside the distribution
Modulates that shaping, a tenth per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates that amount, a tenth per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Picks that distribution by voltage in place of the knob, 0-10V across the seven settings
The outside signal the spacings are taken from while the distribution is set to EXT, scaled by the knob beside the distribution
Modulates that shaping, a tenth per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates that amount, a tenth per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Sets that spread by voltage in place of the knob, 0-10V across none to a full octave
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the random source cannot be seeded
Sets that number by voltage in place of the knob, 1V to 10V across the whole span
The pitch, 1V per octave with 0V at middle C, one channel per voice
Nothing in the module reads this jack; there is no reset

outputs.text: The wave, with its constant offset removed

notes: the sound is never the same twice: every pass through the points moves each height and spacing again, within the limits set by the two Scale knobs
at a Scale of 0 the points stop moving and the wave settles, which is the way to hold a sound in place
